item.text:
**5B.5 Verdict:** mixed, leaning yes. Trọng’s 2024 record contains strong anti-corruption enforcement against top officials and a major tycoon-banker network, but it also shows a campaign that was politically disruptive, economically costly, and not enough to eliminate entrenched capture.

| Title | Publisher | Date | Claim-level summary | QIDs |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Vietnam tycoon gets death sentence in $12-billion fraud case` | ThePrint (ReutersFeed) | 2024-04-11 | The Truong My Lan conviction is strong evidence that the regime under Trọng was willing to hit a politically connected business figure for embezzlement, bribery, and bank-rule violations. It cuts against tolerance for oligarchic capture, even though the case also shows how large the capture problem had become. | 5B.5, 5B.4 |
| `Vietnam parliament backs chairman's resignation amid anti-bribery drive` | ThePrint (ReutersFeed) | 2024-05-02 | The legislature approved Vuong Dinh Hue’s resignation after corruption cases reached people around him. That is direct evidence of elite discipline rather than favoritism or insulation for top insiders. | 5B.5, 5B.2 |
| `Exclusive-Vietnam mounts 'unprecedented' $24 billion rescue for bank engulfed in giant fraud, documents show` | MarketScreener (Reuters) | 2024-04-16 | The central bank’s extraordinary rescue of SCB, a bank effectively controlled through proxies by Truong My Lan, shows how deep politically connected capture had run. The state response was corrective, but the need for such a rescue is counterevidence that capture had been successfully prevented. | 5B.5, 5B.3, 5B.4 |
| `Vietnam’s anti-graft crackdown chills supply chains, investment` | Reuters via Investing.com | 2024 | Reuters described the anti-graft drive as creating uncertainty, approval delays, bottlenecks, and spillovers into projects and power supply. That weakens any claim that the campaign cleanly protected the economy through predictable, rules-based anti-corruption enforcement. | 5B.5, 5B.4 |
| `Exclusive-Vietnam forfeits billions of dollars in foreign aid amid anti-graft freeze, document says` | Reuters via ThePrint | 2024-05-17 | Reuters reported that the anti-corruption drive produced administrative paralysis, delayed approvals, and lost aid. This supports the view that Trọng was fighting graft, but not in a way that consistently preserved normal, non-politicized governance. | 5B.5, 5B.4 |
| `Vietnam removes third top leader in two months, reshuffles cadres` | Reuters via ThePrint | 2024-05-20 | Reuters said the anti-graft campaign created upheaval, infighting, and a chilling effect on bureaucracy. That is evidence of discipline and anti-corruption intent, but also of a politicized system that was not cleanly separating merit from loyalty. | 5B.5, 5B.2, 5B.4 |
| `Vietnam’s top leader Trong dies at 80, party says` | Reuters via ThePrint | 2024-07-19 | Reuters’ obituary credited Trọng with anti-corruption drives. This is the best broad pro-enforcement evidence that his governing frame was anti-rent rather than openly permissive of corruption. | 5B.5 |
| `Vietnam tycoon sentenced to death in $12.5 billion fraud case` | ThePrint (ReutersFeed) | 2024-04-12 | Reuters noted that the crackdown had been pursued for years and that the Lan case was part of it, but also that there had been few tangible results before this wave of prosecutions. This is useful as counterevidence: the campaign was real, but not fully successful in eliminating corruption. | 5B.5 |

**Search gap**
- I found strong 2024 evidence on anti-graft enforcement, but not credible evidence that Trọng had a family-based patronage network or that he personally used business partners for enrichment.
- The strongest “no” evidence is indirect: major fraud/capture persisted, the anti-graft drive destabilized administration, and the campaign did not produce a clean, depoliticized market order.
- After July 18, 2024, Trọng’s effective direct control ended, so late-2024 anti-graft outcomes are only indirectly attributable to him.
